text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I lost again... When the losses keep 
piling up like this, it really takes a 
toll on ya.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I gave it everything I had because I 
wanted to become a star just like her.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
In the end, though, I was just some 
worthless brat acting tough, playing the 
clown just to look like the star of the 
show.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm really pathetic... aren't I? Go on, 
Trainer, you laugh too.

Trainer, you laugh too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Still...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Trainer... with me...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: No way! Now this is a true laughingstock!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I have someone right by my 
side who believes in me and cheers me on 
like this..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Moping around and feeling sorry for 
yerself, there's nothin' more uncool than 
that!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm wide awake now, Trainer. So keep your 
eyes on me, ya hear?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I shall definitely show you. 
The finest victory befitting a true star."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Being serious... What does that mean...?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Kh!?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on, not so loud! What if somebody 
overhears—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh, fufu, fufufu... Sorry, that just 
really cracked me up..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ahahaha! Come on, now. When told 
to laugh at a time like this, there aren't 
many folks who'd actually burst out 
laughing, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's hilarious. ...Thanks to you, 
though, that took the weight off my 
shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Whether we mope or smile, what we need to 
do to win doesn't change."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I am alright now. Starting tomorrow, I 
shall patiently resume my training once 
more!"
